es.tpl.name: Revisión trimestral
es.tpl.description: Revisa resultados, embudo comercial y operación del trimestre, analiza desvíos contra metas y prepara prioridades y un resumen ejecutivo.
es.step.financials.title: Resultados financieros de {{quarter}}
es.step.financials.desc: Resumir ingresos, costos, márgenes y flujo de caja de {{quarter}} con sus cifras clave.
es.step.funnel.title: Revisar el embudo comercial
es.step.funnel.desc: Analizar oportunidades, conversión y ciclo de venta de {{quarter}} frente a lo planeado.
es.step.operations.title: Revisar la operación
es.step.operations.desc: Evaluar entregas, tiempos, capacidad y calidad de {{quarter}} frente a los compromisos.
es.step.variance.title: Analizar desvíos contra metas
es.step.variance.desc: Comparar los resultados de {{quarter}} con las metas, explicar los desvíos relevantes y su evidencia.
es.step.priorities.title: Definir prioridades del siguiente trimestre
es.step.priorities.desc: Proponer prioridades para el trimestre siguiente a {{quarter}}, con responsables y metas sugeridas.
es.step.summary.title: Resumen ejecutivo
es.step.summary.desc: Redactar el resumen ejecutivo de {{quarter}} con resultados, desvíos y prioridades para la dirección.

en.tpl.name: Quarterly review
en.tpl.description: Reviews the quarter's results, sales funnel and operations, analyzes deviations from targets, and prepares priorities and an executive summary.
en.step.financials.title: Financial results for {{quarter}}
en.step.financials.desc: Summarize the revenue, costs, margins and cash flow for {{quarter}} with their key figures.
en.step.funnel.title: Review the sales funnel
en.step.funnel.desc: Analyze opportunities, conversion and sales cycle for {{quarter}} against the plan.
en.step.operations.title: Review operations
en.step.operations.desc: Evaluate deliveries, lead times, capacity and quality for {{quarter}} against commitments.
en.step.variance.title: Analyze deviations from targets
en.step.variance.desc: Compare the {{quarter}} results with the targets, and explain the relevant deviations and their evidence.
en.step.priorities.title: Set next quarter's priorities
en.step.priorities.desc: Propose priorities for the quarter after {{quarter}}, with suggested owners and targets.
en.step.summary.title: Executive summary
en.step.summary.desc: Write the executive summary of {{quarter}} with results, deviations and priorities for management.
